basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old medical student currently studying in the EU. My journey with OCD has been a challenging one, but I’m proud of the progress I’ve made. When I’m not buried in medical textbooks, I enjoy listening to Panic! At The Disco and following football, especially FC Masterrace and Lazio. I live in a small apartment in a lively city, which I love exploring during my free time. I’m often online during late-night study sessions or in between classes. Single and focusing on my studies and personal growth.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in medical sciences, primarily due to my ongoing studies in medical school. Additionally, my personal experience with OCD has made me quite knowledgeable about mental health challenges. I often read up on the latest research and engage with communities to learn more.
